repo:objectstack#7 · os-alice · session_011y7As88pUDUZHGdwFmizG4

## 维护者速读
- 动作的整页编辑器和 Studio 对象「操作」页里,脚本动作的「拒绝目录」和「文本」不再显示成原始 JSON,改为按服务端表单的键值行加帮助文字来编辑。
- 属于 Studio 动作设计器这条线,补上服务端已声明、但设计器没读的两行。
- 出错的话只影响这两行的显示,存储与服务端校验都不变;可直接撤回。
- 无需你操作;钩子页同类问题待立后续卡(见第 5 项)。

## 席位核对

Verdict: **ACCEPT** at head `dd2958b30da3fde02d48bcaa671b41dee2a641a7` (read 2026-11-23T14:16Z).

1. **Shape.** Open, draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #35650`. `Fixes` is right: the card's implementable hosts are both wired (full-page editor via `ResourceEditPage` designer branch, Studio object Actions view via `DataPillar` → `ObjectActionsPanel`), each with a pin, plus the zh-CN overlay leaves; the create-page host is a falsified premise (item 2), so nothing implementable is left. No closing keyword binds another card. `mergeable_state: clean`.
2. **Premise measured.** Create page: re-read on the head. `PreviewComponent` is undefined in create mode unless the type is in `CREATE_MODE_CANVAS_TYPES` (`object`, `report`, `dataset`, `doc`), so an action's create page never takes the designer branch and renders the flat `createSchema` form (`anchors.ts`, Label/Name/Object/Icon). The dev's correction of the card stands and is stated in the PR body. `StudioBundleItemEditor` mounts only email templates, translations and datasets (`StudioMetadataArea.tsx` header), never an action: right to leave unchanged. zh-CN leaves match the platform bundle `zh-CN.metadata-forms.generated.ts` label for label (action `refusals*`/`texts*`, hook `texts*`).
3. **Gates at this head (check-runs).** 39 success · 13 expected skip · 0 unexpected skip · 0 failed · 0 pending; Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check both `success` (`l1-face.mjs --pr 36688`, clean on all 13 items). The full app-shell suite the dev did not run locally is answered by CI at this head.
4. **Accepted deviations.** Tests: both pins build the page from the real served `actionForm` and `ActionSchema` (`@objectstack/spec/ui`), not a hand fake; positive control present (ablation of `ActionDefaultInspector.tsx` to main turns 3/3 red with the raw-JSON textareas, restored to blob `16b68477`). The round-trip pin parses the saved body with `ActionSchema.safeParse`. The issue-row wiring moves the fallback form from the host's setter to `useIssuePrefixRegister` (the existing #35628 register) so the two forms report a union; on main only the fallback form reported, so the host hears a superset, never less. Changeset read sentence by sentence against the diff: every sentence true. It names the private `@object-ui/app-shell`, as other changesets on `main` do; `Check Changeset` is green.
5. **Out of scope.** (a) Acceptance note: the Studio object's Hooks view (`ObjectHooksPanel` → `HookDefaultInspector`) shows hook `refusals`/`texts` as raw JSON. Same defect class, not fixed here — owed ONE follow-up card by the area through the filing gate (no open card found at read time). (b) Seat observation, read on the tree, not run, for the same card: a global action opened from an app's nav leaf (`navSurface.ts` `case 'action'`) mounts `ActionDefaultInspector` on the Studio canvas rail (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, the no-selection `DefaultInspector` branch) with neither `serverSchema` nor `serverForm`, so that host draws no "More fields" and neither row in any face. Pre-existing, not touched by this diff, not the host the card described. `Skills-docs:` not owed (`Metadata-protocol: none`, no narrowing arm).
6. **Landing.** No contract face: no `packages/spec/src/**`, no governed path, no `Clause-②: yes`, no narrowing, so no L2 is owed; this record is the review of record at `TIER_DEFAULT`. No `content/docs/releases/` path. SQL push-down: not applicable (UI wiring only). Land on this head; any head move needs a fresh read.
